Do NOT chop into many short fragments (that trips choppy-rhythm) and do NOT convert to bullets (that would break the meaning). Suggested split: '...diagram creation are useful across projects, so. -> I keep canonical copies in my agents repository...' Test: can you write a single lead-in line that all the commas finish without re-introducing the subject or verb? Yes -> bullet list. No -> split into 2-3 sentences.
